notes:
Summary: enterprise RAG/search vendor evaluating embeddings + cross-encoder reranker for multilingual portal. Heavy focus on per-language recall/precision tuning and predictable cost per query.

Context/Org: Aurora builds an internal knowledge graph + multi-tenant search layer for a 20-country sales org and support center. Their dataset is 200M documents (mix: product docs, EU legal translations, support transcripts). Primary challenge: consistent recall across languages (en, fr, de, es, pt, nl, sv, it, ja, ko).

Technical requirements (from DS lead):
- Index scale: target 100M+ vectors, incremental daily ingestion 500k docs. Need compact 384d embeddings for storage cost but maintain cross-lingual recall.
- Latency SLOs: median query latency <= 120ms for single-shot search paths; rerank (cross-encoder) budget <= 350ms end-to-end for top-50 candidates.
- Throughput: 200 QPS steady, burst to 1000 QPS for campaign windows.
- Cost sensitivity: aiming for $0.0008 - $0.002 per query (embeddings + rerank amortized).
- Model preferences: prefer open multilingual encoders (LaBSE / sentence-transformers multilingual models) for first-stage; cross-encoder reranker based on XLM-R fine-tuned on in-house bilingual relevance labels. Open to Redwood-verified variants.
- Routing/fallback: per-region routing, per-language fallbacks (if a language lacks a dedicated model, fallback to nearest compatible mmodel), pinning for legal languages (FR/DE) to keep residency.

Security/compliance notes:
- Must support SSO/SAML, KMS-backed keys, audit logs retained 7 years for compliance team review.
- Data residency: EU-only storage for documents originating in FR/DE offices.

POC plan and timeline (as of recent activities):
- 2026-01-12: kickoff call (Miguel + DS lead), collected sample corpora (100k multilingual docs).
- 2026-01-26: baseline eval with local sentence-transformers (ffwd: baseline recall@10 by language attached in Drive).
- 2026-02-09: Redwood hosted API demo; streamed reranking prototype (notes: streaming helps UX but we need strict latency SLO).
- 2026-02-18: POC remote session (recorded, Fireflies id ff_2026-02-18_aurora_poc_call). Ran indexed ~2M vectors on Redwood Dedicated dev pool; measured median retrieval latency 95ms, end-to-end rerank 340ms for en/es; de/fr slightly higher (370-420ms) indicating model selection issue.
- 2026-03-02: Cost runbook review; finance asked for per-query cost estimate across dedicated vs hosted with autoscale.

- "We need parity in recall between EN and FR at the 95th percentile — anything less breaks legal workflows." — DS lead, paraphrase.
- "Can you show us routing that keeps FR/DE documents inside eu-west while still giving low tail latency?" — Head of Infra.
